purpose: Exploratory reusable visual references; not evidence of an onboarding-triggered request.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed onboarding background, wide landscape 16:9.
Primary request: A breathtaking but calm science-fiction coastal landscape: a winding clear river through dark coastal cliffs opens onto a long pale beach and expansive ocean. Elegant restrained futuristic architecture integrated into the left cliff, with fine warm ivory and very subtle cyan AI-inspired light details. Technology belongs quietly in the landscape.
Style/medium: premium cinematic environment art with realistic natural textures, atmospheric depth, sophisticated restraint.
Composition/framing: wide scenic view, river curves from lower left toward central ocean, architecture on left third. The right half must remain visually calm, subdued deep blue ocean and misty sky with broad low-detail tonal areas so a light onboarding form can sit there. Full image edge to edge, no inset panels.
Lighting/mood: blue hour after sunset, soft apricot light on distant horizon, dramatic coastal scale yet peaceful and inviting.
Color palette: deep ink navy, muted teal river and sea, pale sand, soft warm horizon and discreet cyan light.
Constraints: no UI, no typography, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no mascot, no floating holographic symbols, no planets, no busy cityscape.

Lighting/mood: quiet blue hour, soft apricot rim light, inviting and calm.

Constraints: actual transparent alpha background. No UI, no text, no logos, no watermark, no mascot, no robots, no people, no floating holographic symbols, no planets, no extra decorative objects, no checkerboard drawn into the artwork.
